name: UTF8PathFopen
signature: constexpr int kWideCapacity = 0x400;      // wide chars per buffer (2 KB) uint8_t __cdecl fn_00783160(FILE** out, const char* path, const char* mode)
summary: Converts a UTF-8 path and mode to UTF-16 (CP_UTF8) and opens the file with _wfopen; stores the FILE* through out and returns whether it is non-null.
